scope: Cumulative engine-integrity patch superseding v0.9.120 and v0.9.121
fixed: Persistent pages are removed from hand without being simultaneously added to discard.
A runtime integrity guard removes any same-instance card found in both in-play and discard zones.
Superstar identity pages are rejected by legality checks and by the resolver as defence in depth.
Generic ongoing Gameplans no longer silently default to a one-round duration when no printed duration is recognised.
Known persistent handlers such as verified Gameplans, Bounce Off the Ropes, and Always Thinking use non-discard hand extraction.

regression_status.full_browser_matrix: not rerun for this focused patch

remaining_certification: Complete move resolution must be asserted beyond the counter-check stage.
Immediate-only Gameplans and unresolved persistent cards still require card-specific lifecycle verification.
Player and CPU strategic choices remain to be unified for all choice effects.
